claims.claim: Browser applications send and receive data with Fetch.
claims.finding: MDN documents requests/responses. Network traffic is separate from where recognition or inference runs.
Official project supports browser OCR; local source establishes this particular application route.

claims.claim: Tesseract worker/core/language paths and language caching can be configured.
claims.finding: Official API documents workerPath/corePath/langPath and IndexedDB caching. Current adapter follows pinned7 worker packets rather than directly calling createWorker; local code and native proof establish this.
Official quality guide explains preprocessing factors. No historical accuracy table is asserted; current English QA supports one fixture.

claims.claim: Transformers.js supports browser text, vision, and speech pipelines.
claims.finding: Official docs cover browser ONNX inference, not privacy of every surrounding application request.

claims.claim: Model-local settings and WASM locations are separate.
claims.finding: Official custom-usage example separates localModelPath/allowRemoteModels from wasmPaths. Installed4.2 source independently confirms default jsDelivr runtime locations.

claims.claim: A localhost Ollama endpoint can forward to cloud models.
claims.finding: Official API docs give local and hosted base URLs and explicitly allow cloud models through a signed-in local server. Localhost alone does not prove local inference.

claims.claim: Ollama has direct hosted cloud processing.
claims.finding: Official docs describe cloud model requests. No live provider health, account configuration, or service privacy audit is claimed.

claims.claim: Clarity masking applies to a marked DOM node and its children.
claims.finding: Microsoft documents data-clarity-mask scope. Masking recording content is not equivalent to stopping all requests or analytics.
